# Loyaltie Connect

> Build day-to-day shopping from independent brands into your agent or app: MCP server, open catalog and cart links. No sign-up or key. Partners earn up to 10% of the whole basket.

- [MCP server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/main/docs/mcp.md): https://loyaltie.com/api/ucp/mcp, 8 tools from search to cart
- [agents.md](https://loyaltie.com/agents.md): the full guide for agents
- [skill.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/main/skill.md): set up any agent to shop Loyaltie
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/main/README.md)
- [Catalog files and fields](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/main/docs/catalog.md)
- [Cart links](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/main/docs/cart-links.md)
- [Earn](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/main/docs/earn.md)
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/main/docs/faq.md)
- [Start building](https://loyaltie.com/connect)
